items.title: EDX Markets partners with Canton to list Canton Coin, settle stablecoins and validate the network
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 9:42 PM ET)
- **EDX Markets partners with Canton to list Canton Coin, settle stablecoins and validate the network** — EDX Markets will list Canton Coin on its institutional-only spot exchange, support settlement in stablecoins on Canton and operate as a validator, strengthening the network's security and governance as adoption scales across global financial markets (Mondo Visione)
- **Taurus adds custody for the Canton Token Standard as a Canton Super Validator** — Taurus now provides custody support for the Canton Token Standard and has joined Canton as a Super Validator, participating in consensus on the Global Synchronizer and helping banks use Canton's privacy and collateral features, building on its infrastructure work for Deutsche Bank, CACEIS, Santander and State Street (Taurus)
- **CIP-0096 ends liveness rewards, leaving activity rewards as the only validator minting route** — Validators now earn Canton Coin only through activity rewards, minted in proportion to CC burned by their users for traffic purchases or transfers; CIP-0096 discontinued liveness rewards for uptime alone, capping them at $0 effective April 30, 2026, while traffic credits remain non-transferable once CC is converted (Canton Network)
- **Canton Dev Fund analysis finds failed votes expire from absent voters, not rejections** — A community analysis of the Dev Fund repository found seven funding votes failed with almost no votes against, expiring after 21 days because the 51%-of-eligible-voters threshold was never met, with four reopened within days; repository labels also undercount failures because reopening a vote resets them (CC Space)

items.title: Tharimmune approved as a Canton Super Validator, the first publicly traded company supported by the Canton Foundation
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 9:12 PM ET)
- **Tharimmune approved as a Canton Super Validator, the first publicly traded company supported by the Canton Foundation** — Tharimmune, Inc. (NASDAQ: THAR) has been approved to operate as a Super Validator, securing transactions and earning Canton Coin rewards to support the digital asset treasury strategy it established in November 2025; the company plans to publish quarterly research on onchain analytics, governance and tokenomics and to host public webinars to drive institutional adoption across capital markets (AInvest)
- **Logical Synchronizer Upgrades are live on Canton MainNet with Canton 3.5 under CIP-0117** — The upgrade mechanism runs new synchronizer infrastructure in parallel with the existing network and switches over automatically in seconds or minutes, preserving all historical data with no migration reloads and no coordinated outages; applications keep running under the same logical synchronizer identity and legacy synchronizers remain available for 30 days before decommissioning (Canton Network)
- **Franklin Templeton's Benji platform sells a tokenized U.S. Treasury to Virtu Financial, settling in USDCx on Canton** — Franklin Templeton brought its Benji fund platform to Canton in November 2025 to give institutions access to tokenized investment products; the following July it sold a tokenized U.S. Treasury to Virtu Financial on Tradeweb, with the trade settling in USDCx, the Canton version of USDC, on the network (Datawallet)

items.title: Canton Foundation launches official Daml 3 developer certification
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 8:12 PM ET)
- **Canton Foundation launches official Daml 3 developer certification** — The Canton Developer Certification pairs free self-paced courses with a $150 certification exam, giving developers worldwide a structured path to build applications for regulated financial markets; based on Daml 3 and Canton 3.x, it validates practical mastery of the authorization and privacy principles behind Canton's contracts and lets existing Daml 2 developers migrate to a single current stack, with Foundation COO Amanda Martin framing it as a common professional standard for the ecosystem (HTX)
- **ClearToken deploys three regulated settlement platforms on Canton** — Under a strategic partnership with the Canton Network, FCA-authorised market-infrastructure provider ClearToken is deploying three Daml-based platforms directly on Canton — CT Register for tokenisation, CT Pay for payment-versus-payment settlement and CT Settle for delivery-versus-payment settlement — spanning fiat, tokenised deposits, stablecoins and cryptocurrencies as the first FMI-calibre settlement infrastructure for stablecoin FX, with a fourth service, CT Clear, to follow once Bank of England authorisation is received (ClearToken)
- **Goldman Sachs, Hong Kong FMI and Moody's Ratings join the Global Synchronizer Foundation** — The three institutions are the newest members of the foundation governing Canton's Global Synchronizer, joining more than 30 participants including Broadridge, Tradeweb and Digital Asset, and will take part in the governance and expansion of the decentralized ecosystem under the Linux Foundation-supported open governance model (Mondo Visione)
- **CIP-0116 ties Featured App status to Canton Coin lock-ups** — Under the adopted proposal, featured applications approved for Canton Coin rewards must lock CC to keep their status — 5 million CC for most apps and 25 million CC for asset issuers, with a 60-day release period — and lose featured status if their lock falls below the required amount (Datawallet)

items.title: HQLAx takes strategic investments from Broadridge and Digital Asset for its Canton migration
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 7:42 PM ET)
- **HQLAx takes strategic investments from Broadridge and Digital Asset for its Canton migration** — The digital collateral mobility provider secured strategic minority investments from Broadridge and Digital Asset in its Series C-1 round to evolve its platform, deepen collaboration with Broadridge's Distributed Ledger Repo platform and migrate to the Canton Network, with both investors set to join its board subject to approval from Luxembourg's CSSF regulator (Broadridge)
- **Temple engages tZERO Securities as broker-dealer and ATS operator for its Canton platform** — Temple Digital Group has engaged SEC-registered tZERO Securities to operate its proprietary tokenized securities trading platform on Canton, pairing Temple's matching engine, RFQ module and central limit order book for tokenized NMS securities with regulated broker-dealer and ATS infrastructure; Temple has executed over $1.6 billion in volume and is the largest platform by transaction volume on the network, with implementation pending (tZERO)
- **Temple drives Canton's DeFi fee growth in CertiK's November 3 snapshot** — Decentralized exchange fees on Canton rose from about $194,000 to about $349,000 across the latest 30-day window, with Temple's fees climbing from about $122,000 to about $277,000 as its trading volume rose from $425 million to $740 million and its share of tracked exchange volume jumped from about 32% to 85%; tracked total value locked rose from about $8.1 million to about $13.7 million, with Temple holding roughly $7.4 million, or 54% (RailsRecord)
- **21Shares TCAN is the first U.S. ETF offering direct Canton Coin exposure** — The 21Shares Canton Network ETF trades on Nasdaq under the ticker TCAN and was the first fund in the U.S. to provide direct exposure to Canton Coin, giving brokerage-account investors a regulated route to CC price performance (The Block)

items.title: Canton Foundation passes 100 members as ISDA and ISLA join legal-standards work
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 7:12 PM ET)
- **Canton Foundation passes 100 members as ISDA and ISLA join legal-standards work** — The Canton Foundation now has more than 100 members, with ISLA and ISDA among the new members working on legal and operational standards for securities-lending initiatives, according to Canton Strategic Holdings President Mark Toomey's third-quarter update on the network's institutional growth (MarketBeat)
- **LSEG appointed a Canton Super Validator, expanding its DiSH settlement role** — London Stock Exchange Group has been appointed a Super Validator, expanding its existing validator role through the cash application of its Digital Settlement House (DiSH); DiSH has already enabled participants to settle intraday repos in DiSH cash in proofs of concept as an alternative to stablecoins, and LSEG says it will support network governance and bring other services onto Canton (LSEG)
- **Kaiko deploys first institutional-grade oracle on Canton's Zenith EVM layer** — Market-data provider Kaiko has deployed the first institutional-grade price oracle on Zenith, Canton's EVM execution layer, live on Zenith testnet now and due in production at the Zenith mainnet launch, giving EVM developers on Canton regulated multi-asset pricing data (CC Space)
- **Five North splits into separate Five North and Loop brands** — Five North has split into two brands: Five North keeps the fund and Super Validator operations, while its products move to Loop — Cantonloop becomes Loop Wallet, the Lighthouse explorer becomes Loop Data, and the Loop SDK serves teams integrating Canton; users' wallets and balances are unchanged (CC Space)

items.title: Visa joins Canton as a Super Validator, announced on its Q4 earnings call
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 6:42 PM ET)
- **Visa joins Canton as a Super Validator, announced on its Q4 earnings call** — Visa's CEO named the Canton Super Validator role on the company's October 30 earnings call, alongside validator roles on Tempo and Circle's Arc as part of Visa's onchain network strategy; the role adds a global payments operator to the institutions running Canton's Global Synchronizer and does not directly change Canton Coin's token economics (TradingView)
- **DA Registry launches Proof of Transfer API for privacy-enabled Canton assets** — Digital Asset's DA Registry now lets wallet and exchange users independently confirm whether a transfer of a privacy-enabled Canton asset succeeded, failed or is pending, without exposing confidential transaction data; Bybit has already integrated the API and Digital Asset is urging other wallets and exchanges to follow (CC Space)
- **Chainlink brings Data Streams, Proof of Reserve and CCIP to Canton as a Super Validator** — Under the partnership, Chainlink's Data Streams, SmartData products including Proof of Reserve, and its Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocol serve Canton applications, while Chainlink Labs runs a domain validator and a synchronizer node as a Super Validator, taking part in ordering and finalizing transactions across the Global Synchronizer; Canton has also joined the Chainlink Scale program (Finance Loop)
- **Kaiko extends its Series B to $110 million, led by S&P Global with Canton participating** — The market-data provider, itself a Canton Super Validator, extended the round to $110 million with S&P Global leading and Canton also participating, a sign of institutional money flowing into the data infrastructure around the network (CC Space)

items.content_text:

- **Canton records over $155 million in Q3 fees, CertiK says** — The network burns Canton Coin to pay for services, while its recorded daily fee pace was below the 30-day snapshot reported in June, so fee income reflects institutional usage that does not reveal the underlying transactions (The Defiant)

items.title: Kaiko joins Canton Foundation collateral workstream to bring trusted pricing to tokenized collateral
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 5:42 PM ET)
- **Kaiko joins Canton Foundation collateral workstream to bring trusted pricing to tokenized collateral** — The market data provider has joined the Canton Foundation's Collateral Sub-Committee and leads its Workstream 2 on Collateral Mobility and Interoperability, bringing Bloomberg evaluated pricing and NCFX regulated FX benchmarks onchain through its Data On-Ramp so central counterparties and market infrastructures can move tokenized Treasuries, repo and cash from pilots to accepted collateral and margin (Kaiko)
- **Hecto launches $NEOPRIME, the first tokenized pre-IPO exposure token on Canton** — Issued by Neoprime on Hecto's infrastructure as a tokenized debenture under British Virgin Islands law, $NEOPRIME gives backed exposure to a basket of late-stage private companies including Anduril, Figure AI, Shield AI and Crusoe, with Erebor as the first completed position; eligibility requires a pre-IPO company valued at $1 billion or more with independent pricing data available (The Block)
- **Canton Summit 2026 recap puts more than 650 firms connected to the network** — Digital Asset's recap of Canton Summit 2026 in New York, with Goldman Sachs, JP Morgan, Nasdaq, HSBC, DTCC and Franklin Templeton among those discussing Canton as rails for global financial markets, notes CEO Yuval Rooz's figure of more than 650 firms connected to the network in two years (Canton Network)
- **Canton approves on-chain enforcement of Featured App and Super Validator locking under CIP-0127** — Super Validators approved CIP-0127, which puts Featured App and Super Validator locking commitments under on-chain enforcement through governance locks of at least 10,000 CC from Splice 0.10.0, so lock-up rules are enforced by the network itself rather than by agreement alone; wallet providers have been asked to expand memo fields to 1,000 characters to encode the lock data (Canton Network Docs)

items.title: Cancore raises $7.2 million seed round to connect Canton assets with public-chain liquidity
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 5:12 PM ET)
- **Cancore raises $7.2 million seed round to connect Canton assets with public-chain liquidity** — The Canton-native platform, live on mainnet since April 2026 as a validator and Featured App, closed the round with Paper Ventures, dao5, ArkStream Capital, X Ventures, MH Ventures and Proof of Talk; as of October 1 it had processed more than $53.2 million in lifetime volume across more than 84,000 trades and generated over $538,000 in protocol revenue, and will use the capital to expand to additional networks and liquidity sources (The Defiant)
- **Three Canton apps lose Featured App status over free-traffic abuse** — The Tokenomics Committee, acting on the Featured App Accountability Committee's recommendation, is revoking Featured App status from Grofty Wallet, Yapper Agent and Ibex for abusing free traffic; the revocations now go to Super Validators for on-chain approval, signalling that reward privileges are being actively policed (CC Space)
- **Nasdaq and Send awarded MainNet validator node allocations** — The Canton Foundation Tokenomics Working Group granted new MainNet validator allocations, including one to Nasdaq, Inc. and three to Send, issued in line with current network capacity and health assessments (CC Space)
- **Derivnex records the first over-the-counter swap on Canton** — DRW and Marex entered a total return swap on the iBoxx USD Liquid Investment Grade Index on October 13, recorded as the first OTC swap on the network (Datawallet)

items.title: Tokenomics Committee approves Stable Coin (SBC) as a Featured App on Canton
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 4:12 PM ET)
- **Tokenomics Committee approves Stable Coin (SBC) as a Featured App on Canton** — The Global Synchronizer Foundation's Tokenomics Committee approved Stable Coin Inc.'s SBC application for Featured App status, which now goes to Super Validators for on-chain approval; the same notice confirms an additional Super Validator weight release for Canton Strategic Holdings under the Digital Asset Treasury programme (CC Space)
- **EDX Markets launches CBTC spot trading, bringing Bitcoin-backed assets to Canton institutions** — EDX Markets partnered with BitSafe to launch spot trading of CBTC, BitSafe's Bitcoin-backed asset on Canton backed 1:1 by Bitcoin, in its first availability on a centralized exchange; Granite River Trading supports liquidity, with CBTC/USD perpetuals planned in the coming weeks and Canton Coin planned as eligible collateral (Morningstar)
- **Canton builds out its South Korea presence through Shinhan, Hanwha and LG CNS** — Shinhan Financial Group has cooperation and strategic investment links with the Canton Foundation, including Shinhan Asset Management approved as a Super Validator, Hanwha Investment & Securities has partnered with Digital Asset and invested in the company, and LG CNS is exploring Canton-based services and infrastructure (Bitrue)
- **Tokenomics Committee pauses Wintip's Featured App status after flagged activity** — The Global Synchronizer Foundation's Tokenomics Committee voted to pause Featured App status for Wintip (Winsnip) on MainNet after on-chain activity was flagged for review by the Accountability Committee; Featured App status boosts the rewards an application earns, so the pause materially changes its economics (CC Space)

items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 3:42 PM ET)
- **Upflam payments and wallet platform opens to everyone on Canton** — Upflam has dropped its invite-only access: anyone can now sign up, create a Canton wallet and take payments through payment links, invoices, donation pages, embeddable buttons, recurring AutoPay and a WooCommerce plugin, with a 0.1% fee on incoming payments (CC Space)

items.title: Canton Foundation backs RedStone pricing tool with 15.8 million Canton Coin
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 2:12 PM ET)
- **Canton Foundation backs RedStone pricing tool with 15.8 million Canton Coin** — The Foundation approved almost 15.8 million CC, worth about $1.55 million, to fund RedStone's open-source Canton Access and Privacy Standard (CAPS) tool, letting institutions value transactions from a shared reference price without revealing their agreed settlement amounts; initial pricing covers tokenized funds, private-market assets and structured products under the Apache 2.0 license (Cointelegraph)
- **Uber completes 24/7 treasury pilot on Canton with HSBC, Franklin Templeton, Tradeweb and Fireblocks** — Uber used HSBC Tokenized Deposits to buy Franklin Templeton tokenized money market fund shares on Tradeweb through delivery-versus-payment transactions on Canton via Fireblocks, and liquidated part of the holding over a weekend while continuing to earn yield throughout the investment lifecycle (HSBC)
- **Societe Generale accepts $10 million in tokenized Treasuries as collateral on Canton** — The bank's Prime Services & Clearing division accepted the DTCC-tokenized Treasuries as eligible collateral, reflecting them in its existing back-office and collateral systems, and intends to develop support for recurring collateral movements and explore onchain repo financing (Societe Generale)
- **Circle reports 379.9 million Canton Coin held at September 30** — Circle's quarterly filing shows 379,921,930 CC with a fair value of about $48.0 million at September 30, 2026, up in quantity from 367,760,063 CC held at December 31, 2025 (Circle Form 10-Q)

items.title: Nomura Group and BOOSTRY approved for Canton Super Validator participation under CIP-0130
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 1:42 PM ET)
- **Nomura Group and BOOSTRY approved for Canton Super Validator participation under CIP-0130** — The November 10 vote passed with 11 in favour and two non-votes, giving the pair one shared arrangement to earn up to 10 reward weight through verified milestones tied to regulated customer access, institutional settlement and collateral integration (CantonNews)
- **OpenZeppelin Daml library and four reference designs clear Canton Dev Fund vote** — The security firm's open-source Daml contracts library and reference designs for a privacy-preserving DEX, a lending protocol, cross-chain stablecoin payments and a fourth design were approved, giving Canton builders vetted, reusable building blocks (CC Space)
- **SEC staff view Canton Coin as a digital commodity in November 3 no-action letter** — Division of Corporation Finance staff said they would not recommend enforcement over programmatic minting of CC by Super Validators, Validators and app providers as described; the letter is a staff position only and does not address secondary-market trading (Unchained)
- **CIP-0129 universal burn timeline points to private synchronizers in Q1 2027** — The first phase would apply universal fee burning to private synchronizers, described as ambitious rather than a firm deadline, with volume-based pricing estimated for Q3 2027 (CoinMarketCap)
